Narito ang mga maiinit na balita sa 24 Oras Express ngayong Biyernes, October 16, 2026.


- P634K halaga ng chicken galantina atbp. karne, nasabat; dinala na sa rendering facility


- Brgy. Captain, pinagbabaril habang naglilinis ng bahay


- Lalaking inaresto sa kasong serious illegal detention, person of interest pala sa pagpatay ng kanyang kinakasama sa Rizal


- VP Duterte sa pag-iimbestiga ni NBI Dir. MAtibag sa umano'y misdeclared 2025 SALN: he's a nobody, 'di ako interesado sa kanya


- Chinese Amb. Jing Quan, ipatatawag ni Pres. Marcos


- Ex-Bansamoro Parliament member at isang taga-PNP Aviation Security Group, kabilang sa 13 persons of interest ng DILG sa pagpuslit ng shabu mula Laos


- Rep. Sandro Marcos sa paglipat sa LAKAS-CMD: 'it was more of an admin matter'; si Speaker Dy ang nagsabi na lumipat ng partido


- Cast ng 'Born to Shine,' may birthday surprise kay Kobe Brown


- Isa sa nanamantala umano sa Grade 9 student at isang may dalang baril, inaresto


- Atty. Baligod at 14 ex-bodyguard ni Co, inaresto dahil sa kasong unjust vexation


- Jessica Soho, isa sa special guest sa 31st anniversary episode ng 'Bubble Gang'; mapapanood na ang part 1 sa Oct. 18


- Dagdag-bawas sa presyo ng ilang produktong petrolyo, posible sa susunod na lingo


- Pagresolba sa kaso ni Sen. Marcoleta, pinakamabilis sa kasaysayan ng Office of the Ombudsman ayon kay Ombudsman Remulla


- Ilang grupo, nanawagan ng mas abot-kayang presyo ng pagkain sa gitna ng mga hamon sa agrikultura


- P2K na laman ng tip box sa tindahan ng fruit shake, tinangay ng delivery rider


- Patrol vessel ng Japan, nakadaong sa Pilipinas; layong mapatibay ang maritime cooperation at relasyon ng 2 bansa


- Kris Aquino, tinawag na 'irresponsible' at 'uninformed opinion' ang mga sinabi sa podcast na nanglait sa anak


- Bagyo, posibleng pumasok sa PAR sa susunod na linggo


- Ilang produkto't serbisyo, inaasahang magmamahal lalo matapos pumalo sa P63-level ang dolyar


- Kim Kardashian, enjoy sa kanyang pre-birthday getaway sa Pilipinas


- Umano'y lider at 2 kasabwat sa pagnanakaw ng e-payment machines, huli sa pier; biyahe umanong Mindoro para doon mambiktima


- 16th Bilateral MCA ng PH at US, matagumpay na isinagawa; Chinese warships at CCG vessel, namataan sa gitna ng aktibidad


- Sen. Pres. Gatchalian, tinanggap ang paumahin ng prosekusyon pero tuloy daw ang imbestigasyon


- Sasakyang kayang lumipad at mag-exhibition sa ere, mayroon na sa totoong buhay

Baru-baru ini, timbul isu yang melibatkan Zetrix AI Berhad dan JPJ berkaitan kontroversi tunggakan bayaran hasil kerajaan, yang sebelum ini dikenali sebagai MyEG. Perbincangan turut tertumpu kepada kaitan syarikat itu dengan UMNO pada masa lalu.

Tetapi adakah itu keseluruhan ceritanya?

Dalam sistem kapitalisme kroni, pertukaran kerajaan tidak semestinya menamatkan hubungan antara perniagaan dengan kuasa politik. 

Apabila kerajaan bertukar, bagaimana pula hubungan dan kedudukan mereka yang dahulunya rapat dengan parti tertentu?

Malam ini, saya akan menelusuri bagaimana syarikat dan ahli perniagaan yang pernah dikaitkan dengan satu parti membina hubungan dengan parti yang kemudian menjadi kerajaan.

Bagaimana jaringan ini bertahan merentasi pertukaran kerajaan, dan bagaimana mereka kembali mendekati puncak kuasa?

snippet.title: Kitty Party Ki Taiyaari Aur Rana Ji Ke Paise 😂 | Crispy Sabudana Paneer Sandwich #sandwich #food
snippet.description:
Aaj maine banaye crispy aur tasty Sabudana Sandwich 😋❤️

Kal meri kitty party hai aur Rana ji ko bas mere paison ki fikar hai! 😂 Unhe kya pata, paise purse mein the… bas purse pant mein tha! 🤣🙈

Aap bhi vrat mein ya evening snacks ke liye ye yummy Sabudana Sandwich zaroor try karna.

Ingredients:

* Sabudana
* Boiled potatoes
* Peanuts
* Green chillies
* Fresh coriander
* Sendha namak / namak (apne vrat ke hisaab se)
* Lemon juice
* Ghee ya oil, roasting ke liye

Method:
Sabudana aur baaki ingredients ko mila kar sandwich ki stuffing taiyaar karein. Sandwich maker ya tawa par ghee/oil laga kar dono taraf se crispy aur golden hone tak sekhein. Garma-garam serve karein! 😍

From my homemade Xander’s babar pasta, to my viral garlic butter chilli oil pasta recipe - you have all loved and devoured every single recipe. But nothing compares to this butler’s pasta au gratin! 

Cutting board: @fusionhomepk 
Featured Reel: @2kbrokegirls 

Recipe ingredients:

Pasta •
1 pack penne pasta (400g)
Water for boiling
1 + 1/2 tsp salt 

Chicken • 
* 500 g boneless chicken breast, cut into small strips
* 1 tsp salt
* 1/2 tsp black pepper
* 1 tsp garlic powder
* 1/2 tsp paprika
* 1 tsp onion powder
* 1 tbsp soy sauce
* 1 tbsp oil

Vegetables • 
1 tbsp butter 
1/2 cup chopped mushrooms
1 green capsicum 

White sauce: 
* 3 tbsp butter
* 2 tsp minced garlic 
* 3 cups milk 
* 2 packs dairy cream
* 1 chicken stock cube
* ½ tsp salt
* 1 + 1/2 tsp freshly ground black pepper
* 1 tsp onion powder
* 1 tsp dried oregano
* 1 tsp dried parsley

* 1/2 cup mozarella cheese
* 1/2 cup cheddar cheese

Black olives and extra cheese for assembling

snippet.title: Can MOAB Destroy Iran’s Nuclear Sites?#iran #iranisraelwar #iranwar #nuclearenergy #nuclear #moab
snippet.description:
According to a CNN report, the US military has developed new strike options targeting Iran’s energy infrastructure and nuclear sites, potentially including the massive GBU-43/B MOAB, nicknamed the “Mother of All Bombs.” If President Donald Trump orders renewed military action, the reported plans could put this enormous conventional weapon in the spotlight.

Weighing around 9,800 kilograms, MOAB is designed to cause extensive blast damage over a large area. But it is not a specialised deep-penetration bunker-buster, meaning it may be ineffective against nuclear facilities buried deep underground beneath thick rock. Its use could also carry significant risks to civilians and surrounding infrastructure.

With diplomatic efforts uncertain and political pressure mounting ahead of the US midterm elections, the reported strike plans raise a critical question: would using MOAB create enough pressure to bring the conflict closer to an end, or risk triggering another dangerous escalation? Even a massive conventional bomb may not be enough to destroy deeply buried nuclear facilities.

The bigger issue is the facility’s location beneath a heavily buried granite mountain. That makes it extremely difficult to target with conventional weapons and could explain why Iran is investing in further hardening. If activity continues to increase, Pickaxe Mountain could become one of the most challenging potential targets in Iran’s nuclear infrastructure.

snippet.title: Japan's Snack Rule Is INSANE?! 😳
snippet.description:
Japan's Snack Rule Is INSANE?! 😳

In Japan, snack packaging is taken seriously, especially when it comes to how the food looks compared to the picture on the box. From the shape and size to the colors and tiny details, companies are expected to represent their products accurately. 

Japan has strict rules against misleading advertising, meaning brands can face legal consequences if their packaging gives customers a false impression.
 
That's why some Japanese snacks look surprisingly similar to their package photos when you open them. Even the placement of chocolate chunks on a cookie can make the resemblance seem almost unbelievable!

In the years leading up to this week’s fatal accident at its Georgia theme park, Six Flags has been accused of failing to maintain its parks amid hundreds of reports of injuries and dangerous malfunctions on its aging thrill rides, according to a CNN analysis of public records and court filings.  

CNN's Kyung Lah has the details and CNN legal analyst Joey Jackson runs through the legal implications for Six Flags. Also, CNN's Isabel Rosales reports on the investigation into 42-year-old Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem's death while riding the Goliath rollercoaster at Six Flags Over Georgia.
